experience.cue: A side grasp of a short object on an open support with nothing overhanging it. The object's centre sits closer to the support top than the gripper's housing/palm hangs below the jaw axis. Symptoms: the hand stalls at the support edge or never leaves the pre-grasp ('entry timed out N cm from the grasp'), or knocks the object. Controller-side probes (slower entry, entry gate off, wider tracking clip) flip nothing.
experience.lesson: Compute the side-grasp height from the gripper's collision outline instead of aiming the jaw at the object centre (pick.py: min_jaw / grasp_pitch). Formula: min_jaw(th) = max over the gripper's low collision points (x along the approach, z up, jaw frame) of (x*sin th - z*cos th) + GRASP_CLEAR_M (0.005 m). Trigger: the object centre is less than min_jaw(0) - 0.005 above the support top (3.4 cm for this gripper) and no surface overhangs the object. Then pitch the wrist GRASP_PITCH_DEG = 15 nose-down and raise both the pre-grasp and the hand program's grasp target to support top + min_jaw(15 deg) (2.76 cm here). Leave every other grasp bit-identical. Checks: the pads must still overlap the object top by >= 0.5 cm (if not, it needs a dedicated pinch). The commanded pitch must actually be delivered. It transferred on a 0.45 m table but not on 1.07-1.12 m shelves, where the arm arrived 14-29 deg off the commanded attitude; treat those as a separate reach problem, not a stance or clearance retune.
experience.evidence: Row iter 1, part 1 (pick.grasp_pitch) is the only mechanism that fires on the coffee-table candle. Diag 0/5 -> 4/5 (s120005/16/26/36), 0 of 50 starts broken. Sealed (held-out) 1/8 -> 7/8, seed -> iteration-1 version. Mechanism corroborated: the rival top-down probe (TOP_FLAT_M 0.03, iter 1 H1) fixed 3 of the same 5 starts, so the cause is removing the level housing-vs-slab conflict. Controller probes flipped 0: ENTRY_GATE off / DASH 0.1 (iter 0 H2) and TRACKING.clip 0.25 (iter 1 H2). Boundary contrast: the same pitch fixed 3 top-shelf candles and 1 bin on diag, but sealed stayed 0/8 and 0/8. Gate for the whole candidate: b 12, c 2, p 0.0065; stage 1 b 4, c 0 on 30 pairs where iteration 0's withdraw-only candidate had b 0.
experience.confidence: medium. Held-out transfer on 8 sealed starts of one task, plus a mechanism confirmed by FK traces and an independent rival fix. But it was gated together with the withdraw (the c 2 is unattributed), and it is shown for one gripper and one low support height. It did not transfer on high shelves.
